name: SSTuner
description:
Picture and sound controls in GNOME Quick Settings.

Adjust brightness, contrast, color temperature and saturation, plus a 3-band equalizer. Picture and sound have separate presets. Sliders move in 1-point steps. Sections start collapsed.

Optional dependencies:
* ddcutil — monitor backlight via DDC/CI (10–100%)
* PipeWire and pw-cli — equalizer
